ABOUT

A bit about me

02 / profile
BIO

I am a kind, down-to-earth, young person with a passion for data analysis.

My goal is to maximize the effective use of data through an optimal approach, leveraging tools like R, Stata, and SQL. By formulating hypotheses, I aim to provide recommendations that help improve specific business situations. Simply, I apply statistical models to make data-driven predictions.

Currently, I have just completed my bachelor's degree and I am pursuing a master's at the Erasmus University of Rotterdam, specialising in Supply Chain Management. Eager to work, I am willing to face any challenge!

WHAT I DO

Statistical modelling — Applying regression, forecasting, and hypothesis testing to real business problems with clear, actionable outputs.

Data analysis — Turning raw datasets into structured insights using R, Stata, and SQL, with rigour and clarity throughout.

Supply chain analytics — Combining business acumen with quantitative tools to optimise logistics, inventory, and operations.

Data storytelling — Communicating findings to non-technical audiences through clean visualisations and structured reports.
